description: Trust-state promotion for the two learning protocols fully reviewed in the 2026-09-15 Research Watch batch. The Evidence Decisions and public protocol boundaries live in review-registry-research-watch-2026-09-15-learning-protocols.json; this supplemental registry makes that completed review explicit to the canonical Trustverse classifier.

prequestions-before-learning.note: Reviewed against the 2025 multilevel meta-analysis. Public guidance is restricted to improved learning for information explicitly targeted by prequestions; the near-zero non-target effect, lack of a universal question dose, and role of feedback remain explicit boundaries.

self-explain-what-you-learn.note: Reviewed against the 2025 three-level meta-analysis of self-explanation in digital learning environments. Public guidance keeps the digital-learning scope, heterogeneity, pacing and knowledge-type moderation, and does not claim one universal prompt, modality, frequency, or superiority over other learning strategies.
